bedside_demo.name: Bedside approach
bedside_demo.description: Move through the clear lane near the foot of the bed, pause, then return to the starting pose.

greeting_demo.name: Arm greeting
greeting_demo.description: Raise the left arm, wave the wrist twice, then return to rest.

phone_return_demo.name: Pick up and put back
phone_return_demo.description: Grip and lift the phone, lower it onto its original riser, open the fingers, then retreat and confirm the phone is settled.

deliver_phone_demo.name: Deliver phone to bedside
deliver_phone_demo.description: Carry a real free body to the accessible bedside tray, confirm support, release, and return.

deliver_meal_demo.name: Deliver meal container
deliver_meal_demo.description: Carry a real free body to the accessible bedside tray, confirm support, release, and return.

blinds_demo.name: Open window blinds
blinds_demo.description: Press a passive sliding control through hand contact; its modeled mechanical linkage rotates the slats.

notes: Full configuration arrays are route and arm goals, never body pose playback
Twenty position actuators move arms/lifts/grippers; two wheel velocity motors provide propulsion through tire-floor contacts
Base X/Y/yaw are passive coordinates; a passive vertical guide loads the tires while roll/pitch remain ideally constrained, without balancing validation
Wheel angles accumulate from physics and are excluded from rest-pose matching
Free-space paths receive sampled collision checks; loaded finger targets are checked through actual contact dynamics
Completion requires measured outcomes and is revoked on fault
